roadmap.title: An upgrade for the blast furnace
roadmap.body:
The Tun upgrades a smelter and the Woodrack a charcoal kiln. The blast furnace has neither.

It gets a piece of its own rather than the Tun learning a second station: a Tun is a picture of ore and coal, and a blast furnace is black metal and stone. Cost and capacity are still being decided.

Capacity only, like the other two. Throughput stays vanilla, so a bigger load means fewer walks back to the station and not faster iron.

roadmap.title: Time left on what is loaded
roadmap.body: A station's hover text will say how long until the ore, wood or coal already in it is finished. It is the game's own number worked out for the whole queue, so Kynda's one rule stays: it never changes how fast anything is made.
